description: Use this when an MCP event subscription should stop. Requires auth. Inputs: id (required, mes_… from cooper_list_event_subscriptions). Keeps the row for audit and returns it with status ended and retained true. An ended row does not deliver and does not count toward the 20 subscription cap. A second delete of the same id returns status ended and retained true again. Another account's id, or an inbox this key cannot see, returns 404 event_subscription_not_found. A key without webhook_write receives 403 permission_denied.
name: cooper_delete_event_subscription

id.description: Stable id of the returned object. Pass it to the matching get, update, or delete tool.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

retained.description: True when the row is kept for history.

title: Stop an MCP event subscription
